principle.title: Check checks, captures and threats
principle.explanation: Before every move, ask: what can my opponent capture, which checks do they have, and what does their last move threaten?

principle.title: Avoid weakening your pawns
principle.explanation: Isolated, doubled and backward pawns are hard to defend and give your opponent targets. Don't create them without a good reason.
